answer: Continuous physical-presence attestation: each identity must periodically solve a challenge that requires holding a distinct hardware device with a factory-fused secret, and the registry accepts only one active identity per device. Every attestation opens a short thread binding device serial to session, so a cloned identity cannot answer the next round without the original hardware. Cross-checking witnessed challenge responses against the device ledger lets the system bridge attestations into one continuous record, while any replay attempt leaves a detectable echo across rounds.
